topic: What $1,000 in Apple stock at its 1980 IPO would be worth today -- and why almost nobody held it that long
title: $1000 in Apple at IPO is Worth $1.7 Million Today
description:
What if you invested $1000 in Apple's 1980 IPO? Today, it would be worth over $1.7 million. But almost no one who bought then still holds the stock, and the reason is a brutal lesson about what long-term investing actually feels like.

#investing #apple #stockmarket #personalfinance #compounding
